title: S3 stat-band — three or four figures set as the display object
idea: Three or four figures at display scale, each with a label and one short line, divided by hairlines. The numeral is the typographic object; the words explain it.
why_new: spec-table sets facts as small aligned label/value pairs. Nothing sets a number as display type, so a site with real figures has nowhere to put them except a card grid that flattens them into paragraphs.
built_from: one wp:columns with a heading at display size per column. No new CSS beyond the divider rule.
risk: invented numbers are the worst failure this generator can produce. Gate it hard: at least three hard figures in the site spec, and no figure that the spec does not state.
